chapters.label: Live: Spain v Hungary
chapters.text: Futsal Euro 2016, in Belgrade. Spain lead Hungary three to one. Alex cuts the ball back, and Miguelín smashes it in. Four to one!

chapters.label: Replay: first time
chapters.text: Watch again. He arrives on time and hits it first time. Spain win five to two. Later, Miguelín is named best player of the Euro!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: His trademark: the clever wing pass. How he does it: on the left wing, look up before the ball arrives. Spot the run, and slide it inside!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Practise it! Look up before the ball arrives, so you know your next pass.
